We conduct our experiments utilizing the Router-Bench dataset (Hu et al., 2024), which consists of 36,497 queries from 8 NLP datasets, including Chinese and English. Each query is answered by 11 different LLMs, with records of responses, as well as corresponding quality and cost metrics.

The response quality score for each query is scaled from 0 to 1, while the query cost is measured in dollars. Any query that exceeds the maximum tolerable waiting time is assigned a quality score of 0.
